column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah 14 (M23014): Basti & Faelynn gugur, Kenny tewas, The Elmo menyergap logistik.
# Tetap Inggris: Basti, Faelynn, Klukai, Andoris, Mechty, Belka, Voymastina, Lentine,
# Kenny, Mokosh, Mangi Security, The Elmo, Squad 404, Doll, Frame, Neural cloud,
# Remolding Pattern.
Remolding Pattern power amplification confirmed—
column2: Penguatan daya Remolding Pattern terkonfirmasi—

column1: Environmental data integration complete, real-time data from Captain Klukai received. Aim... fire!
column2: Integrasi data lingkungan selesai, data langsung dari Kapten Klukai diterima. Bidik... tembak!

column1: (The particle cannon fired a brilliant beam with an almost limit convergence rate, and the particles focused on one point continuously wore down the defensive force field on the mobile platform.)
column2: (Meriam partikel melepaskan sinar menyilaukan dengan tingkat pemusatan nyaris maksimal, dan partikel yang terfokus di satu titik terus menggerus medan gaya pertahanan di platform bergerak itu.)

column1: Basti, Faelynn! Now!
column2: Basti, Faelynn! Sekarang!

column1: (At the moment Andoris's particle cannon attack ended, the two Dolls who had been approaching the mobile platform in a crawling state suddenly threw off their camouflage and rushed directly into the mobile platform behind the defensive force field. Mangi Security, distracted by the particle cannon, was unable to stop this boarding operation.)
column2: (Tepat saat serangan meriam partikel Andoris berakhir, dua Doll yang selama ini merayap mendekati platform bergerak itu tiba-tiba melempar kamuflasenya dan langsung menerjang masuk ke platform di balik medan gaya pertahanan. Mangi Security yang perhatiannya teralih oleh meriam partikel tak sanggup menghentikan operasi naik itu.)

column1: (And Klukai also opportunely fired thermal smoke grenades, obscuring the vision of Mangi Security attempting to return for support, buying more time for Basti and the other.)
column2: (Dan Klukai juga tepat waktu menembakkan granat asap termal, mengaburkan pandangan Mangi Security yang hendak kembali membantu, mengulur lebih banyak waktu untuk Basti dan rekannya.)

column1: (After Faelynn blocked the rapid shotgun fire from the close-range anti-personnel defense weapons, Basti quickly threw bombs to destroy the defense facilities. Both Dolls simultaneously fired their grappling hooks, rapidly ascending toward the bridge in a relay fashion.)
column2: (Setelah Faelynn menahan tembakan senapan gentel bertubi dari senjata pertahanan anti-personel jarak dekat, Basti cepat melempar bom untuk menghancurkan fasilitas pertahanannya. Kedua Doll serentak menembakkan kait tambatnya, memanjat cepat ke arah anjungan secara bergantian.)

column1: Captain, the external shield has been breached by enemy fire, and two enemy Dolls... have begun invading the platform!
column2: Kapten, perisai luar tertembus tembakan musuh, dan dua Doll musuh... mulai menyerbu masuk ke platform!

column1: Dolls? Prioritize taking down the closest enemies; don't let them near the bridge!
column2: Doll? Prioritaskan menjatuhkan musuh yang paling dekat; jangan biarkan mereka mendekati anjungan!

column1: The speed is too fast... we are trying!
column2: Kecepatannya terlalu tinggi... kami sedang berusaha!

column1: (Even the Dolls of that "Commander", in front of a mobile platform carrying nearly a hundred personnel and equipped with a large number of defensive weapon systems, couldn't possibly cause too much of a stir—)
column2: (Bahkan Doll milik "Komandan" itu, di hadapan platform bergerak yang membawa hampir seratus personel dan dilengkapi banyak sistem senjata pertahanan, mustahil bisa berbuat banyak—)

column1: (In just a few seconds, this perception was completely overturned.)
column2: (Hanya dalam beberapa detik, anggapan itu dijungkirbalikkan sepenuhnya.)

column1: (Bathed in a hail of bullets, they pulled each other onto the platform with exquisite cooperation, while not forgetting to make precise counterattacks, probing the weaknesses of the defense line.)
column2: (Bermandikan hujan peluru, mereka saling menarik naik ke platform dengan kerja sama yang indah, sambil tak lupa melancarkan serangan balik yang presisi, menguji titik lemah garis pertahanan.)

column1: (The mobile platform Lentine was on was the hub of the battlefield, but because she brought the heavy troops too close to the front line, the number of infantry capable of stopping the two Dolls was severely insufficient.)
column2: (Platform bergerak tempat Lentine berada adalah pusat medan tempur, tapi karena dia membawa pasukan berat terlalu dekat ke garis depan, jumlah infanteri yang sanggup menghentikan kedua Doll itu sangat kurang.)

column1: (Outside, Squad 404, as well as Voymastina in the sky, kept Lentine overwhelmed. It was somewhat wasteful to use heavy mechs to bombard them, and the close-in weapon system couldn't rapidly destroy their frames.)
column2: (Di luar, Squad 404 dan Voymastina di udara membuat Lentine kewalahan. Memakai mech berat untuk menggempur mereka agak mubazir, dan sistem senjata jarak dekat tidak bisa cepat menghancurkan frame mereka.)

column1: (The Mangi Security commander made a prompt decision to recall the mechs that were about to assault Mokosh, which forced the Dolls at the base of the platform to retreat, but dealing with the two Dolls who had already infiltrated inside wasn't as simple.)
column2: (Komandan Mangi Security cepat mengambil keputusan menarik kembali mech yang hendak menyerbu Mokosh, sehingga para Doll di kaki platform terpaksa mundur, tapi menangani dua Doll yang sudah menyusup ke dalam tidak sesederhana itu.)

column1: What's going on? Why hasn't it been dealt with yet? Aren't they everywhere—
column2: Ada apa ini? Kenapa belum juga beres? Bukankah mereka ada di mana-mana—

column1: These damn Dolls!
column2: Doll sialan!

column1: Attention, they are carrying a large amount of explosives. Suppress them, I will handle this.
column2: Perhatian, mereka membawa banyak bahan peledak. Tekan mereka, aku yang akan menangani ini.

column1: (The door was blasted open by a high-energy bomb, and two Dolls rushed onto the deck.)
column2: (Pintunya diledakkan bom berenergi tinggi, dan dua Doll menerjang masuk ke geladak.)

column1: (Although Basti's movements were as elusive as a cat's, and Faelynn's speed was faster than a bullet, the Mangi Security members stationed on the deck were enough to form fire coverage and block their movement paths.)
column2: (Meski gerak Basti selincah kucing dan kecepatan Faelynn melebihi peluru, personel Mangi Security yang berjaga di geladak cukup untuk membentuk hujan tembakan dan menutup jalur gerak mereka.)

column1: (However, as if they had just encountered a little trouble while shopping, they quickly counted and organized the weapons on hand.)
column2: (Namun, seolah baru menemui sedikit gangguan saat berbelanja, mereka cepat menghitung dan menata senjata yang ada di tangan.)

column1: Aha, the weather forecast didn't say it would rain today—isn't it pouring quite vigorously?
column2: Aha, ramalan cuaca tidak bilang hari ini hujan—kok deras sekali begini?

column1: Probably specially prepared to welcome us, right?
column2: Mungkin disiapkan khusus untuk menyambut kita, ya?

column1: It would be a bummer to have rain on the wedding day with Darling.
column2: Sayang sekali kalau hari pernikahan dengan Sayang malah hujan.

column1: Then let's hold an indoor wedding. Basti, you have to hold my wedding dress properly.
column2: Kalau begitu kita adakan pernikahan di dalam ruangan saja. Basti, kau harus memegangi gaun pengantinku baik-baik.

column1: Okay, okay, what the heck—! I'm the bride!
column2: Iya, iya, apa-apaan—! Akulah pengantinnya!

column1: Ready—let's go! That arrogant woman must be the commander here—
column2: Siap—ayo! Perempuan sombong itu pasti komandan di sini—

column1: (Basti threw out a large number of fully shaken and mixed 'spray cans'. The moment the cans hit the bullets, they erupted into colorful smoke, and the two Dolls used this to quickly dash out.)
column2: (Basti melemparkan banyak 'kaleng semprot' yang sudah dikocok dan dicampur habis-habisan. Begitu kaleng-kaleng itu terkena peluru, meletuslah asap warna-warni, dan kedua Doll memanfaatkannya untuk melesat keluar.)

column1: (The Frame strengthened by the Remolding Pattern quickly broke through the fire blockade and pounced on Lentine. The Dolls' shots poured onto her, but were all defended by the force field shield.)
column2: (Frame yang diperkuat Remolding Pattern cepat menembus blokade tembakan dan menerkam Lentine. Tembakan para Doll menghujaninya, tapi semuanya ditahan perisai medan gaya.)

column1: (But after Basti threw a special grenade, and Faelynn shot through it when it touched the shield, Lentine felt her body blown away by a strong force, crashing heavily onto the console.)
column2: (Tapi setelah Basti melempar granat khusus, dan Faelynn menembaknya tepat saat menyentuh perisai, Lentine merasa tubuhnya terlempar oleh daya yang kuat, menghantam keras ke konsol.)

column1: Gah—!
column2: Argh—!

column1: Tch, as expected it's not that easy—this force field shield is high-end stuff.
column2: Cih, memang tidak semudah itu—perisai medan gaya ini barang kelas atas.

column1: Commander!
column2: Komandan!

column1: (Kenny, wearing the mech, blocked the Dolls' bullets with his body. Then, Mangi Security's hail of bullets poured onto the two Dolls.)
column2: (Kenny yang mengenakan mech menahan peluru para Doll dengan tubuhnya. Lalu hujan peluru Mangi Security menghantam kedua Doll itu.)

column1: (Faelynn, who was originally charging at the front, reflexively jumped up and blocked Kenny's shot. Although she also struck a series of sparks on Kenny's mech, her gun-holding hand was soon torn apart by large-caliber ammunition, and her body lost balance and fell down.)
column2: (Faelynn yang semula menerjang di depan refleks melompat dan menahan tembakan Kenny. Meski dia juga memercikkan rentetan bunga api di mech Kenny, tangan yang memegang senjatanya segera tercabik amunisi berkaliber besar, dan tubuhnya kehilangan keseimbangan lalu jatuh.)

column1: (At the same time, Faelynn lifted Basti with one hand and threw her out.)
column2: (Di saat bersamaan, Faelynn mengangkat Basti dengan satu tangan dan melemparkannya keluar.)

column1: Thanks, partner.
column2: Terima kasih, rekan.

column1: Waaah! Quick, shoot, shoot!
column2: Waaah! Cepat, tembak, tembak!

column1: (A large number of bullets poured onto Faelynn, who was already unable to move. Her body swayed and she fell forward, but she still stubbornly crawled forward until more bullets completely tore her Frame apart, triggering the explosion of the Remolding Pattern.)
column2: (Peluru menghujani Faelynn yang sudah tak sanggup bergerak. Tubuhnya oleng dan jatuh ke depan, tapi dia tetap keras kepala merangkak maju sampai lebih banyak peluru mencabik habis Frame-nya, memicu ledakan Remolding Pattern.)

column1: (The Mangi Security soldiers were thrown into disarray by this unexpected attack, and this also gave Basti the necessary opportunity.)
column2: (Para prajurit Mangi Security kacau balau oleh serangan tak terduga itu, dan itu memberi Basti kesempatan yang dia butuhkan.)

column1: (Her bullets slipped through the gaps in Kenny's defense, testing the defense of Lentine's force field shield.)
column2: (Pelurunya menyelinap lewat celah pertahanan Kenny, menguji kekuatan perisai medan gaya Lentine.)

column1: Ignore the fallen one! Protect the commanding officer!
column2: Abaikan yang sudah jatuh! Lindungi perwira komando!

column1: Kenny, come back here!
column2: Kenny, kembali ke sini!

column1: Don't push yourself—
column2: Jangan memaksakan diri—

column1: (In order to get as close to the target as possible, Basti almost borrowed all the cover on the mobile platform, as well as the enemies she could use. Just to make it inconvenient for the enemy to launch a direct attack on her.)
column2: (Demi sedekat mungkin mencapai sasarannya, Basti nyaris memanfaatkan semua perlindungan di platform bergerak itu, termasuk musuh-musuh yang bisa dia pakai. Semata agar musuh sulit menyerangnya secara langsung.)

column1: (Although Faelynn blocked most of the bullets before, Basti's Frame still had multiple damages. This not only slowed down her speed, but the reckless extreme actions also exacerbated the disintegration of her Frame. She knew very well that her success rate was constantly dropping.)
column2: (Meski tadi Faelynn menahan sebagian besar peluru, Frame Basti tetap rusak di banyak titik. Itu bukan hanya memperlambatnya, gerakan ekstrem yang nekat juga mempercepat hancurnya Frame. Dia sangat sadar peluang keberhasilannya terus menurun.)

column1: (Although strictly speaking, she and Faelynn had already caused considerable casualties and losses to the mobile platform, and the mission had long been completed—)
column2: (Meski secara harfiah dia dan Faelynn sudah menimbulkan korban dan kerugian besar bagi platform bergerak itu, dan misinya sudah lama tuntas—)

column1: Darling's—enemy—is it, you!?
column2: Musuhnya—Sayang—apa itu, kau!?

column1: (Basti didn't know Lentine, but seeing the tight protection the other party received, she realized she had set her sights on a big fish.)
column2: (Basti tidak mengenal Lentine, tapi melihat betapa ketat orang itu dilindungi, dia sadar telah mengincar ikan besar.)

column1: (And the Doll just gave a faint glance. The light flashing in her heterochromatic eyes was enough to chill Kenny to the bone, but he still ignored Lentine's order and charged at the other party.)
column2: (Dan Doll itu hanya melirik sekilas. Cahaya yang berkelebat di matanya yang berbeda warna cukup membuat Kenny merinding sampai ke tulang, tapi dia tetap mengabaikan perintah Lentine dan menerjang ke arahnya.)

column1: What a nuisance!
column2: Merepotkan sekali!

column1: Don't even think about it!
column2: Jangan harap!

column1: (With the power of his mech, Kenny grabs Basti who was trying to jump over his head, and the two crash to the ground in front of Lentine.)
column2: (Dengan tenaga mech-nya, Kenny menangkap Basti yang hendak melompati kepalanya, dan keduanya jatuh menghantam lantai di depan Lentine.)

column1: (The members of Mangi Security try to support Kenny, but during the scuffle between the two sides, they don't dare to rashly attack using heavy firepower.)
column2: (Personel Mangi Security berusaha membantu Kenny, tapi selama keduanya bergumul, mereka tak berani gegabah menyerang dengan daya tembak berat.)

column1: (No—the Remolding Pattern and Neural cloud's overclocking have already exceeded safe limits, it can't last much longer—)
column2: (Tidak—overclock Remolding Pattern dan Neural cloud sudah melewati batas aman, ini tidak akan bertahan lama—)

column1: (Just one step left, only one step away.)
column2: (Tinggal satu langkah lagi, cuma satu langkah.)

column1: (In front of the enemy's bridge, the joint of Basti's left leg has completely broken down. A heavy mechanical arm firmly clamps onto her Frame, completely restraining her.)
column2: (Di depan anjungan musuh, sendi kaki kiri Basti hancur total. Sebuah lengan mekanis berat mencengkeram erat Frame-nya, mengunci geraknya sepenuhnya.)

column1: (Interestingly, Basti didn't feel resentment towards the enemy in front of her—the other party was undoubtedly also protecting someone important, and his reckless posture aroused her respect—considering the other party was a human of flesh and blood, perhaps he was braver than herself.)
column2: (Anehnya, Basti tidak merasa dendam pada musuh di hadapannya—orang itu jelas juga sedang melindungi seseorang yang penting, dan sikapnya yang nekat justru membangkitkan rasa hormatnya—mengingat orang itu manusia berdarah daging, mungkin dia lebih berani daripada dirinya sendiri.)

column1: Wait...
column2: Tunggu...

column1: Kenny, you idiot! Step back!
column2: Kenny, bodoh! Mundur!

column1: —What a pity, sorry, this is war.
column2: —Sayang sekali, maaf, ini perang.

column1: (Dazzling light burst from Basti's body. With the final glow of the Remolding Pattern, her Frame also exceeded its limit and broke free from the mech's restraints.)
column2: (Cahaya menyilaukan meledak dari tubuh Basti. Dengan pijar terakhir Remolding Pattern, Frame-nya pun melampaui batas dan lepas dari cengkeraman mech itu.)

column1: (Although this came with the price of her Frame almost completely breaking, she still successfully shook off her opponent and planted a bomb inside Kenny's power unit.)
column2: (Meski harganya adalah Frame-nya yang nyaris hancur seluruhnya, dia tetap berhasil melepaskan diri dari lawannya dan menanam bom di dalam unit tenaga Kenny.)

column1: (The impact of the explosion tore Kenny's armor open from the inside, blood splattering. Basti staggered, threw Kenny off, and raised her gun at Lentine—)
column2: (Hantaman ledakan itu merobek lapis baja Kenny dari dalam, darah muncrat. Basti terhuyung, menyingkirkan Kenny, dan mengangkat senjatanya ke arah Lentine—)

column1: (A saber popped out from the back of the mech's hand, piercing through Basti's chest and Remolding Pattern—she let out a whimper, and the bullet harmlessly grazed past Lentine's temple.)
column2: (Sebilah pedang mencuat dari punggung tangan mech itu, menembus dada Basti dan Remolding Pattern-nya—dia merintih, dan pelurunya hanya menyerempet pelipis Lentine tanpa melukai.)

column1: ...Sorry, Darling...
column2: ...Maaf, Sayang...

column1: (The damage to the Remolding Pattern triggered a fierce explosion. Basti's face disappeared in the smoke, becoming the most brilliant fragments in the center of the battlefield.)
column2: (Kerusakan Remolding Pattern memicu ledakan dahsyat. Wajah Basti lenyap dalam asap, menjadi serpihan paling gemilang di tengah medan tempur.)

column1: (The huge impact caused the entire Mangi Security command platform to tremble violently. Fortunately, Kenny leaped and blocked his body in front of Lentine.)
column2: (Hantaman besar itu membuat seluruh platform komando Mangi Security berguncang hebat. Untungnya Kenny melompat dan menghalangi dengan tubuhnya di depan Lentine.)

column1: No—
column2: Tidak—

column1: (With the smoke rising from the platform and the disappearing force field shield, as well as the completely interrupted communication of Basti and Faelynn.)
column2: (Dengan asap yang membubung dari platform dan perisai medan gaya yang lenyap, serta komunikasi Basti dan Faelynn yang terputus sepenuhnya.)

column1: (Klukai and Voymastina could confirm that the enemy's command post suffered heavy damage, but the Dolls also had no more strength to attack, and were constantly forced back by the approaching heavy mechs.)
column2: (Klukai dan Voymastina bisa memastikan pos komando musuh rusak berat, tapi para Doll juga sudah tak punya tenaga untuk menyerang, dan terus dipukul mundur oleh mech berat yang mendekat.)

column1: Basti—Faelynn! Damn it, can't contact them.
column2: Basti—Faelynn! Sial, tidak bisa dihubungi.

column1: Klukai, let's retreat, the enemy will attack soon!
column2: Klukai, ayo mundur, musuh akan segera menyerang!

column1: We've already achieved very sufficient battle results—let's praise Basti and Faelynn after we go back.
column2: Hasil tempur kita sudah lebih dari cukup—kita puji Basti dan Faelynn setelah pulang nanti.

column1: Understood, fall back to C1!
column2: Dimengerti, mundur ke C1!

column1: (The alarm in the platform command room kept ringing. Subordinates advised Lentine to evacuate immediately, but her eyes were fixed on the incapacitated mech not far away.)
column2: (Sirene di ruang komando platform terus meraung. Para bawahan menyarankan Lentine segera menyingkir, tapi matanya terpaku pada mech lumpuh yang tak jauh dari sana.)

column1: (The damaged mech had exposed the operator inside, and blood was gushing out—suffering an explosion impact at such a close distance, even with the protection of the mech, death was almost a certainty.)
column2: (Mech yang rusak itu memperlihatkan operator di dalamnya, dan darah mengucur deras—terkena hantaman ledakan sedekat itu, sekalipun terlindungi mech, kematian nyaris pasti.)

column1: (Fury, hatred, sorrow... complex emotions almost washed away Lentine's reason. Before leading her former old subordinates into Mangi Security, she had made a promise to let everyone live a "good life".)
column2: (Murka, benci, duka... emosi yang berkecamuk nyaris menghanyutkan akal sehat Lentine. Sebelum membawa para bawahan lamanya masuk ke Mangi Security, dia sudah berjanji akan membuat semua orang hidup "layak".)

column1: (Kenny was not the first comrade she lost, but he was the most important comrade who witnessed her journey all the way.)
column2: (Kenny bukan rekan pertama yang dia kehilangan, tapi dialah rekan terpenting yang menyaksikan perjalanannya sampai sejauh ini.)

column1: (And it was precisely because she was too eager for success that it led to such consequences.)
column2: (Dan justru karena dia terlalu terburu-buru meraih hasil, akibatnya jadi seperti ini.)

column1: Damn Dolls, kill them all for me!
column2: Doll sialan, habisi mereka semua!

column1: Step aside, I'll do it myself!
column2: Minggir, aku sendiri yang akan melakukannya!

column1: Everyone listen up, use all firepower, kill all enemies on sight.
column2: Semuanya dengar, pakai seluruh daya tembak, bunuh semua musuh yang terlihat.

column1: Execute full fire coverage, wipe out all enemies!
column2: Laksanakan hujan tembakan penuh, musnahkan semua musuh!

column1: (Lentine had already abandoned the defensive posture for the mobile platform, switching to an all-out attack. The target of the first strike was the nearby area that had recently caused significant damage to the mobile platform's shield.)
column2: (Lentine sudah meninggalkan sikap bertahan untuk platform bergerak itu, beralih ke serangan habis-habisan. Sasaran gempuran pertamanya adalah area terdekat yang barusan menimbulkan kerusakan besar pada perisai platform.)

column1: (Charging up most of the firepower and bombing the target. Even if the Dolls not far away attempt to escape, in the face of sufficiently large firepower coverage, the other party has no chance to escape at all.)
column2: (Mengisi sebagian besar daya tembak lalu menggempur sasaran. Sekalipun para Doll yang tak jauh dari sana berusaha kabur, di hadapan hujan tembakan sebesar itu, mereka sama sekali tak punya peluang lolos.)

column1: Go quickly! Andoris!
column2: Cepat pergi! Andoris!

column1: (Mechty and Belka, who were originally surrounding Andoris to provide cover, could only retreat in a sorry state in the face of the enemy's powerful fire support.)
column2: (Mechty dan Belka yang semula mengelilingi Andoris untuk melindunginya hanya bisa mundur dengan babak belur di hadapan dukungan tembakan musuh yang dahsyat.)

column1: (Before Andoris could evacuate to a safe area, a laser cannon had already completely hit the area where Andoris was.)
column2: (Sebelum Andoris sempat menyingkir ke area aman, sebuah meriam laser sudah menghantam telak area tempat Andoris berada.)

column1: (A huge explosion occurred after the Frame was attacked. Mechty and Belka were completely overturned to the ground by the aftermath of the explosion before they could dodge.)
column2: (Ledakan besar terjadi setelah Frame itu dihantam. Mechty dan Belka terjungkal ke tanah oleh gelombang ledakan sebelum sempat mengelak.)

column1: Andoris! Retreat!
column2: Andoris! Mundur!

column1: (The Frame was severely damaged, and mobility was almost completely lost. The next wave of attacks had already arrived. Belka rushed towards Andoris, whose casualty status was unknown, without hesitation, hoisted her up, and quickly evacuated.)
column2: (Frame-nya rusak parah, dan kemampuan geraknya nyaris hilang sepenuhnya. Gelombang serangan berikutnya sudah tiba. Belka menerjang ke arah Andoris yang tak diketahui kondisinya tanpa ragu, memanggulnya, dan cepat menyingkir.)

column1: (Resistance had lost its meaning at this time. Attacks like a mantis trying to stop a chariot would only continuously expand the casualties. Timely avoiding the attack became the only solution at present.)
column2: (Perlawanan sudah kehilangan maknanya saat itu. Serangan bak belalang sembah menghadang kereta perang hanya akan terus menambah korban. Menghindari serangan tepat waktu jadi satu-satunya jalan keluar saat ini.)

column1: (BOOM—)
column2: (BUUM—)

column1: (A sky-high explosion sound came from the rear of the Mangi Security forces. Mangi Security's formation fell into a violent chaos.)
column2: (Suara ledakan yang membelah langit datang dari barisan belakang pasukan Mangi Security. Formasi Mangi Security jatuh ke dalam kekacauan hebat.)

column1: What happened?!
column2: Apa yang terjadi?!

column1: Commander Lentine, bad news!
column2: Komandan Lentine, kabar buruk!

column1: It's the Elmo! It directly launched a surprise attack on our logistics unit!
column2: Itu Elmo! Mereka langsung menyergap unit logistik kita!

column1: Our bunker busters and artillery were all taken... it looks like their main force is over there!
column2: Bom penembus bunker dan artileri kita semuanya diambil... sepertinya kekuatan utama mereka ada di sana!

column1: Moreover, their Dolls occupied our missile positions. Before retreating, they not only destroyed them all but also caused massive losses to our side.
column2: Selain itu, Doll mereka menguasai posisi rudal kita. Sebelum mundur, mereka bukan cuma menghancurkan semuanya tapi juga menimbulkan kerugian besar di pihak kita.

column1: HQ has already received a massive amount of complaints about us!
column2: Markas sudah menerima keluhan bertubi-tubi tentang kita!

column1: ...What did you say?! This side... was the bait...?
column2: ...Kau bilang apa?! Sisi ini... umpannya...?

column1: Could that Commander have been on The Elmo from the very beginning!?
column2: Jangan-jangan Komandan itu sejak awal ada di Elmo!?

column1: Damn it!
column2: Sialan!

column1: (Even a focused particle cannon couldn't truly pierce the defensive force field. After just tens of seconds of particle irradiation, the weapon in Andoris's hands was already letting out a wail of overload.)
column2: (Bahkan meriam partikel yang terfokus pun tak benar-benar bisa menembus medan gaya pertahanan itu. Hanya setelah beberapa puluh detik penyinaran partikel, senjata di tangan Andoris sudah meraung kelebihan beban.)

column1: (The dazzling particle cannon drew the attention of everyone on the battlefield, and this momentary decoy was enough to complete the tactical deployment formulated by the Dolls.)
column2: (Meriam partikel yang menyilaukan itu menyita perhatian semua orang di medan tempur, dan pengalih perhatian sesaat itu cukup untuk merampungkan penempatan taktis yang disusun para Doll.)

column1: (The special explosive in Basti's hand flew out, and with a loud bang, turned a force field generator into scrap metal.)
column2: (Bahan peledak khusus di tangan Basti melesat, dan dengan ledakan keras, mengubah satu generator medan gaya jadi rongsokan.)
